notes: Reference date 2018-03-02. Governing document: the OU-AAUP Faculty Agreement 2015-2020 (2018_04), a collective agreement covering full-time and regular part-time faculty except OUWB School of Medicine; missing = false (the no-policy coding (`missing`) does not apply).

2018_02 (CETL handbook 2017-18) is an orientation guide: no leave terms; it says 'Paid and unpaid leaves are provided through Faculty Agreement'. 2018_03 (AHR brochure, 2015) summarises Agreement ¶¶171, 171a, 174, 38f/179b (2012-15 numbering, same paragraph numbers as 2015-20) consistently with 2018_04; its 'Modified Schedule' item appears in no governing text (c15, summary_only). 2018_00 is a student newspaper article (Jan 2017), not policy: a chair says 'There is no maternity leave policy'; the CHRO says paid leave during FMLA 'varies depending upon the employee group and related accrual policies' up to six months, and that faculty may be approved for unpaid leave of up to one year including for child care; departments arrange ad hoc 'service projects' after a 12-week FMLA leave. These correspond to c1/c2, c3 and c11; the ad hoc service-project practice is not a stated provision and is not coded.

No dedicated maternity, paternity, parental or adoption leave exists in the Agreement (C1 absent). A birth parent's paid time comes from the general ¶171c disability leave (pregnancy and childbirth disabilities are covered; pay up to six months at regular compensation), a generic plan under V1 (no childbirth-specific period or length).

¶173 last paragraph: faculty needing leave for pregnancy-related disability or childcare 'may be eligible for paid leave under Article XX, the FMLA and partial leaves under this Article, or a combination of such leaves, in accordance with Oakland's policies and procedures' - a pointer to c1/c2, c3, c12; Oakland's leave policies and procedures are not saved.

Not components: sabbatical and professional development leaves (¶¶162-170; purposes professional, not usable for a birth); bereavement leave (¶171b); reduced work schedule before retirement (¶134; age 58 and 15 years' service).

Cited but not saved: Oakland's disability leave policy (¶171c); Oakland's leave policies and procedures (¶171c, ¶173); Appendix K FMLA rights notice (blank in the saved text); Appendix M health care coverage (blank, image only); OUWB Faculty Handbook (brochure; covers medical-school faculty outside the unit); the 2012-15 Agreement (linked by the brochure, superseded); unit Workload Policies and Review Statements (¶¶41, 69); benefit summaries (oakland.edu/uhr/benefits); Administrative Policy #475 (smoking).
Calendar: Agreement ¶207 'two semesters, each of which shall be a maximum of 16 calendar weeks' -> term_weeks 16.

Chain, birth parent: ¶171c disability leave of absence up to 6 months (c1) with its full pay within it (c2), FMLA 12 weeks concurrent from its start (c3) -> unpaid extended-illness leaves up to 3 years (+6 months final) once paid ¶171c leave is exhausted (c5); LTD insurance pays 60% after 180 days of total disability (c6, no duration). Tenure clock +1 year (c7 / c8).

Chain, non-birth parent: FMLA 12 weeks unpaid (c3), standing alone; c4 (12-week family-care leave) only after own FMLA use for a serious health condition, left unlinked. General leaves (c11 unpaid leave of absence, c12 partial leave) are flagged general_purpose and counted in no figure.
U8: c4 and c8 restrictions recorded as ambiguous restriction flags; c5's final six-month leave is in duration_max (R13b).
